CHAMP-RULES_FTUE.title: Stance Dances
CHAMP-RULES_FTUE.body1:
Certain cards, relics, and other effects let the Champ enter a [gold]Stance[/gold].
The three Stances are Berserker, Defensive, and Ultimate.
CHAMP-RULES_FTUE.body2:
While in a [gold]Stance[/gold], playing a [gold]Skill[/gold] triggers its [gold]Skill Bonus[/gold], a small extra effect like gaining [gold]Vigor[/gold].
You can only trigger it a limited number of times before entering a Stance again to reset the count.
CHAMP-RULES_FTUE.body3:
Some cards have a {:finisher()} [gold]Finisher[/gold] effect and can only be played while in a [gold]Stance[/gold].
Playing one triggers that effect and leaves the Stance.
